label: Causal forest pattern
note: Same statewide total (central); the causal forest only changes where permits land. It predicted where better than our model in held-out tests, but not how many.
method: Each place's share is its causal-forest addition for 2027 to 2031 divided by the forest's Wisconsin total. Each year, the adopted central statewide addition is split by those shares, so every year and the five-year total add up to the adopted central figures. Places with no single-family homes get 0. Counties add up their places. Assembly and Senate districts use the same block-based split of each place as the main map. Held-out test (run 3, 5 seeds): median log error for where rates land 0.98 to 0.99 for the forest against 2.27 for our model; for how many permits, the forest was worse (0.253 against 0.218 over the 5 seeds).

units.rate: additional permits per 1,000 single-family homes per year, 2027 to 2031
